title: Build unified normalised training GeoPackage from seed data
description: Consolidate the three seed regions (data/raw: Canada 653, Nepal 411 UTM44N w/ sparse Class, Pakistan 853) into one GeoPackage with a normalised schema (region, class, source, geometry); reproject to a common analysis CRS or per-region UTM; convert the richer Canada v2 INTERLIS superset (1160 lines) and decide if it supersedes the 653-line set. See data/DATA_MANIFEST.md. Parent: Phase 0.

title: Phase 6 - Packaging & release
description: Epic. QGIS plugin-repo submission, docs, first-time-user tutorial. Verify dependency-free v1 installs cleanly on Windows/macOS/Linux (OSGeo4W). GPL licence; state shipped-model provenance if ML included. Can release classical-first without waiting on Phase 5. See ARCHITECTURE.md S11, S16.

title: Recommend default multi-band input stack + Sentinel-2 composite
description: Combine P1a/P1b findings into a recommended default input stack and a geology-oriented S2 false-color composite (e.g. SWIR 12-11-2). Resolves Q1. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Dependency-free derivative engine (TPI, slope, hillshade, curvature)
description: Compute the configurable multi-band stack from DEM + Sentinel-2 using numpy/scipy/GDAL ONLY (no opencv/scikit-image, D11): TPI, slope, multi-azimuth hillshade, plan/profile curvature, + S2 false-color composite. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.2, S11.

title: Phase 1 report: recommendations + bootstrap verdict
description: Synthesise P1a-P1d into a short report: recommended input stack, chosen v1 detector, and the bootstrap go/no-go verdict. Updates Decisions Log (Q1, Q2, Q10) in ARCHITECTURE.md. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Phase 2 - Classical detection MVP
description: Epic. Implement Phase 1's chosen classical detector + vectorisation (threshold -> skeletonise -> trace -> Douglas-Peucker), DEPENDENCY-FREE (numpy/scipy/GDAL). Deliverable: AOI -> auto-drawn candidate trace polylines layer. Detector lives behind a swappable interface (S5.3). See ARCHITECTURE.md S8.1.

title: Training-data bootstrap GO/NO-GO gate
description: CRITICAL GATE. Test map-draping to auto-generate labels and decide go/no-go for the v2 ML path. Probe failure modes: concealed/inferred contacts (no surface signal), thin-feature registration offset (2-3 px label error on 1-2 px features), generalisation smoothing away the Vs, heterogeneous licensing/datums. Review what map2loop learned about map-linework reliability. Output: a clear verdict + fallback plan (seed + active learning). Resolves Q10. Parent: Phase 1. See ARCHITECTURE.md S8.3.

title: Review most-diagnostic DEM derivatives for bedding/contacts
description: Literature + experimental review (run on the Canada tile) of which DEM derivatives best expose bedding/contacts: TPI, curvature, openness, sky-view factor, etc. Feeds the default input stack. Resolves part of Q1. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Sentinel-2 cloud masking + temporal compositing + scene-ID provenance
description: SCL/QA cloud masking + seasonal-median temporal compositing + scene selection (single scenes are often cloudy). Pin resolved scene IDs + acquisition dates into output provenance for reproducibility. Resolves Q7. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.3.

title: Review modern edge/line detection implementable in numpy/scipy
description: Evaluate classical (Canny, ridge/valley, phase congruency via FFT, Hough) and note DL options (U-Net/SegFormer/Aghaee CNN) for v2. CONSTRAINT: v1 candidates must be implementable with numpy/scipy/GDAL only (D11). Pick the v1 detector. Resolves Q2. Parent: Phase 1.

title: AOI -> STAC fetch: GLO-30 DEM + Sentinel-2 L2A (AWS Earth Search, anonymous)
description: Resolve AOI (draw/import/extent) -> STAC query against AWS Earth Search/Element84 (genuinely anonymous, D13) -> fetch/stream Copernicus GLO-30 DEM + Sentinel-2 L2A COGs, mosaic + clip to AOI. MPC only behind a signing shim if used. Evaluate plain requests vs pystac-client to stay dependency-free. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.1.

title: Phase 1 - Research spike
description: Epic. Lit + experimental review to choose the input stack and v1 detector, and to run the training-data bootstrap GO/NO-GO gate. Run experiments on the existing Canada tile. Deliverable: a short report with a recommended input stack, a chosen classical detector, and a bootstrap verdict. Resolves Q1, Q2; gates Q10. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.2, S8.3.

title: Per-AOI metric CRS policy (custom TM/Lambert or tiling)
description: Derive a per-AOI projected CRS (transverse Mercator/Lambert centred on AOI) or tile the AOI; handle UTM zone straddle and polar AOIs (>84N/>80S) where UTM is undefined. Metric CRS is required by the plane-fit engine. Resolves Q6. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.3.

title: Phase 3 - Strike/dip engine
description: Epic (CORE SCIENCE). Sample DEM along reviewed traces -> PCA/SVD best-fit plane -> strike/dip. Acceptance criteria: (1) TWO degeneracy metrics - conditioning lambda2/lambda1 (primary guard) + planarity lambda3/lambda2 (D12); (2) propagated dip/strike uncertainty + computed GLO-30 error budget (S6.4); (3) SYNTHETIC-DEM recovery gate passes BEFORE any real data, incl. dip-direction downslope sign check (D14, S6.6); (4) windowed vs single-centroid output decided (Q5). Reuse qgSurf/GeoTrace math. See ARCHITECTURE.md S6, S10.

title: Phase 5 - Supervised ML detector
description: Epic (gated on the Phase 1 bootstrap verdict, Q10). Assemble training set (bootstrapped maps if go + seed + active learning), train from-scratch semantic-seg model (U-Net/light transformer) -> skeletonise -> vectorise, export to ONNX, ship as OPTIONAL 'smart detect' upgrade via onnxruntime fetched on first use (D3, D11). State model data provenance/licence before shipping (S16). See ARCHITECTURE.md S8.

title: Phase 4 - Human-in-the-loop UX + triage
description: Epic. The review gate AND the triage system that makes it scale (S9.1): editing tools, bedding/contact/fault/drainage/reject classification panel, confidence-ranked review queue, batch accept/reject, DEM-computable drainage auto-reject (flow accumulation), tunable parameter panel, guided vs one-click modes. Also the versioned project-state schema + re-detect-vs-preserve-edits policy (Q8). See ARCHITECTURE.md S9, S10.

title: Survey open-source structural datasets (strike/dip + lidar/aerial-derived) for training & validation
description: Survey and catalogue openly-licensed datasets to bolster training and (especially) validation: (a) structural measurement databases with strike/dip points (StraboSpot, USGS NGMDB/GeMS OrientationPoints, state surveys, Macrostrat, Geoscience Australia, BGS, GSC); (b) lidar/photogrammetry-derived structural orientation datasets and virtual-outcrop sets; (c) datasets pairing mapped contact/bedding traces with DEMs. For each: name, contents, format/access, coverage, LICENSE, and usability as training labels vs ground-truth validation vs both. Feeds the Phase 1 report and the validation strategy (Q4); related to the bootstrap gate. See ARCHITECTURE.md S6, Q4. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Scaffold QGIS plugin skeleton + repo + CI + dev env
description: Plugin Builder skeleton, git repo (SSH), CI, dev environment, QgsTask background-worker harness (S5.3). Parent: Phase 0.

title: Phase 0 - Foundations & data backbone
description: Epic. QGIS plugin skeleton + the data backbone. Deliverable: draw an AOI in QGIS and get a clean, reprojected multi-band raster stack (DEM derivatives + cloud-free Sentinel-2 composite). Dependency-free (numpy/scipy/GDAL only, D11). See ARCHITECTURE.md S5, S7, S11. Sub-tasks track the detail.
